newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 20.625 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 20.625 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates remained steady on Monday in continued abundant money supply, traders said.
"I suppose money is flowing back to the market from the central bank's reverse repo facility," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Overnight rates traded between 20.50 and 20.875 percent and closed at 20.625 percent, unchanged from Friday's close.
Traders said earlier that liquidity on the interbank overnight market rose after the National Bank of Hungary did not cut repo and reverse repo rates, as market players expected.
